failure_definition: Implant-abutment screw loosening causing restoration failure
causal_mechanism: Mechanical loosening due to insufficient preload retention under cyclic masticatory forces
current_device_behavior: The dental implant supports a restoration, which is secured by an implant-abutment screw made from titanium (Ti-6Al-4V)
blocking_constraint: The need to maintain identical geometry and torque protocol while replacing the screw material
